title: Lantern with a smiling face
svg:

  <circle cx='58' cy='53' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 62 Q50 70 58 62' fill='none' stroke='#7a4010' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='61' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9e9e' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='61' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9e9e' opacity='0.7'/>
